children: Torm's shares were under pressure after investor OCM Njord Holdings priced an offering of the oil-tanker operator's shares.
In premarket trading, Torm's shares were 6.5% lower at $33.05 on Nasdaq.

The company said Oaktree Capital Management-owned OCM Njord launched an offering of 9 million of Torm's class A shares that will raise gross proceeds of about $290.3 million. OCM Njord, which currently owns about 20% of Torm's A shares, has granted the underwriter of the stock sale a 30-day option to buy up to an additional 1.4 million shares.
The offering is expected to close Wednesday.
